$comment: Waiting for components that haven't landed: button-group-demo and button-group-rtl (Dropdown Menu; button-group-demo is shown on Button's page too, and mapped here, its inventory page), button-group-dropdown (Dropdown Menu), button-group-select (Select), button-group-popover (Field). The unit that lands the last of each one's components ports it onto the Button Group page (button-group-demo onto Button's too) and maps it here. Each of those but button-group-rtl also puts a Tooltip, Popover, Dropdown Menu or Select inside a group, and waits for that to work: the overlay's root, an element with display: contents where Radix's renders none, is the group's child, so the group's child rules (joined corners, one border between items) reach it and miss the trigger inside. button-group-nested and button-group-input-group wait for the same, though their components have all landed (Input Group, Tooltip): each puts a Tooltip's root inside an Input Group, around an addon or around an addon's button, where the rules for what is directly inside (the input's end padding beside an inline-end addon, a button's pull into its addon's padding) miss it.
